name: Wind Rider
summary: At Freewind Post, Elu hopes to join the Horde’s wind riders. He asks you to gather wild wyvern eggs at Highperch, where the Horde needs more mounts.

sections.title: The Call of the Sky
sections.body: Across Kalimdor, wind riders carry Horde couriers, scouts, and warriors over long distances. At Freewind Post, young tauren Elu hopes to join their ranks. The Horde needs more mounts, so Elu has been asked to help find new wyverns for its master wind riders. He asks travelers for help.

sections.title: Ascending Highperch
sections.body: Highperch rises above the Thousand Needles mesas and is a prime nesting ground for wild wyverns. To gather viable eggs, you climb the cliffs and face adults guarding their roosts. Elu hopes the eggs will prove his dedication. Then he can begin raising and training wyverns for the Horde’s flight masters.

faq.answer: Elu gives you this work from atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. He hopes to become a wind rider.
Elu asks you to bring him ten Highperch Wyvern Eggs from nests in Highperch.
Highperch lies northwest of Freewind Post and just south of Whitereach Post. A natural ramp marked by a totem pole leads from the canyon floor to the nesting grounds.

faq.q: Why is the Horde gathering wild wyvern eggs?
faq.answer: The Horde’s master wind riders face growing demand for aerial mounts across their outposts, and captive breeding cannot keep pace. Raising wyverns from wild clutches gives handlers new mounts to train for transport and scouting.
Yes. Wild wyverns fiercely defend their broods and readily attack anyone who approaches their clutches on Highperch.

faq.q: What does Elu intend to do with the eggs?
faq.answer: Elu hopes the eggs will let him begin formal wind rider training and raise wyverns to bond with and serve the Horde in the skies.

angles.text: Wyverns carry the Horde across Kalimdor. Replenishing their stables matters for communication and defense on the frontier.
As a tauren, you can take pride in the wind riders of Freewind Post, who honor the care and training of wyverns.
As a hunter, you know the care and peril involved in taking wild clutches from a territorial predator’s nest.
